```{r}
### backlog charts for state pages; the including page sets srs_state,
### solve_coverage, show_solved, state_name_text and no_solve_data_text
### pages without solve-rate data skip the charts
if (show_solved) {
  backlog_offenses <- add_backlog(srs_state, solve_coverage)
  state_backlog_charts <- backlog_charts(
    backlog_totals(backlog_offenses), backlog_offenses, state_name_text
  )
  backlog_headline_text <- backlog_headline(backlog_offenses)
}
```
